scope: Single sealed six-context batch, source-capture replay, current-session native computation and raster. Saved-only accounting.

adoption.interpretation: P denotes availability of an additional entry. All six executed native algorithms and six raw views. Causal product-algorithm benefit is unmeasured.

availability_cohort_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive availability-cohort ratios on three fixed pairs. Zero P entry adoption prevents attribution to active-observation algorithms. No significance or full R&D net benefit claim.

parent_process.scope: Parent before invocation through all sequential slots and controller return. Captured stdout/stderr and this receipt are published after the closed timestamp.

batch.scope: Entire fixed sequential batch through aggregate result write/close.

launch.scope: Main launch call through qualification, fixed batch, source readback and launch-result publication. Interpreter import and this final timing receipt publication are outside this clock.

whole_formal_timing.nesting: Parent contains launch, launch contains batch, batch contains sequential slots. Nested and residual clocks are not added to parent again.

pre_freeze_static_corrections: Base material color is independently shaded during pixel validation.
Packet answer SHA binds original bytes.
Native whole-call profiling removed to avoid uneven instrumentation.
Necessary preparation requalification can follow a concrete shared-source wiring repair.

recorded_validation_window.scope: First fake invocation through saved geometry/pixel qualification, including intervening preparation work. Initial source authoring and total R&D cost unmeasured.

preparation.scope: Recorded-capture module preparation. Same source geometry, raw depth/RGB and raw triangle-to-patch mapping verified. Normal error/recovery/image/EOF checked.

totals.byte_scope: PNG/base64/JSON/stdout/archive and payload figures describe nested representations. They are not summed as independent network or memory allocations.

unknowns.usage_scope: CLI labels turn/session scope unconfirmed and aggregation null. One recorded usage event per fresh one-user context. Cached input is a subset of input and reasoning output a subset of output; neither is added again.
unknowns.reconnect_scope: No retry observations or top-level CLI errors in these six records. Raw provider request coverage remains unobserved; interrupted-stream usage coverage retains the original unknown value.
unknowns.encoding_scope: Bytes are measured. Standalone encode/decode CPU time is not independently clocked; it is nested in tool/frame/outer intervals.

next_direction: Validate actual routing into the available production active-observation entry on the next authorized task, then verify its returned facts are used. Keep native computation as the shared baseline.

saved_only_audit_prepublication_correcti.correction: Iterate the actual sealed list of path/sha256 rows. No formal input changed.

audit_scope.saved_arrays_inspection: Standard-library NPZ/NPY headers and payload hashes only; no product import or geometry evaluation.
